Name: Kenneth's Neon Nights
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Neon Nights[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A pack of 20 tracks with a neon / synthwave feel. Made for late nights in-game when you want something more atmospheric and retro.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]Arcade[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Chase[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cosmic[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cruise[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Digital[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Dreams[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Electric[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Future[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Heartbeat[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Midnight[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Neon[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Nostalgia[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Pixel[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Skyline[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Sunset[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Synthwave[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Time[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Traveler[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Waves[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tracks are added to the Mini-Jukebox and ready to play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install: Drop the folder into Mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Only adds new music, no replacements, works fine with existing saves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my music mods are separate packs but fully compatible. You can install just one or all of them at the same time with no conflicts.[/b][/size]
